content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the VNSGU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being advertised by VNSGU?
faq.answer: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University (VNSGU) is recruiting for the post of Temporary Assistant Professor on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Temporary Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Temporary Assistant Professor position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q5. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What are the required qualifications for the Temporary Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is in Marketing Management or General Management.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the VNSGU located?
faq.answer: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University is located in Surat, Gujarat, with the pincode 395007.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Temporary Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
